name: 25404 · Martinsburg, WV
findings: ZIP 25404 (Martinsburg) has 52 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 25404 (Martinsburg) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 25404 (Martinsburg) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 9 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
